subject: Request: Exec concession for unexpected model outage impacting LumenX launch
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenx.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, contracts@lumenx.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenX integration — production errors during canary

Hi Rishi,

We started the canary yesterday evening and saw repeated 500s when model A (rwd-7b-v1) was routed for fallback. It appears the model instance pool returned UNAVAILABLE for ~18 minutes during peak traffic between 20:35–20:53 PDT. That window caused 4 downstream job failures for our ingestion pipeline — two of which missed internal SLAs for early access customers.

We appreciate the quick debug call last night. LumenX legal is asking if Redwood can provide a commercial concession for the outage window (the launch timeline is fixed, and this impacted our paid trial cohort). Please advise next steps and what paperwork is needed.

Best,
Samir
Head of Platform, LumenX

--
Attachment: incident-log-20281001.txt (text/plain, 14KB)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: LumenX integration — production errors during canary

Team — forwarding Samir's note. Quick summary: model variant pool had a temporary availability regression under a micro-upgrade we rolled Friday night; infra triaged and restored capacity. Customer requests a commercial concession for the impacted minutes (trial cohort).

Asks:
- Monica: can you confirm the actual customer impact (# failed requests / billing units) and whether they were charged for retries?
- Kar: what's the current commercial posture we should take (credit vs one-time discount vs extended pilot)?
- Laura & Priyom: if legal/finance need a short SOW amendment or addendum, flag the minimum wording.

We should aim to respond to Samir within 24 hours with a concrete proposal.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: LumenX integration — production errors during canary

Rishi — I pulled request logs. Impact summary: 1,240 API calls received during the 18-minute window; 94 of those returned 5xxs and 21 retried and eventually succeeded (we do not bill for retried tokens if retried within 5 minutes per our retry policy). Net billable impact: ~73 failed calls; estimate token-level exposure ~12k tokens.

Customer is on a reserved trial committed bucket for the pilot (no monthly commitment yet). Riley (CS) confirms two early-access customers saw user-facing failures; churn risk moderate if we don't make a good-faith gesture.

Suggesting options to propose:
- Option A: One-time credit equal to billed amount for the 73 failed calls (~$1,100)
- Option B: 20% discount on next month of usage up to $5k
- Option C: Extended pilot by 30 days + priority SLT on-call for launch week

I can draft wording for any option.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: LumenX integration — production errors during canary

All — thanks Monica. Commercial guidance: for strategic pilot customers we try to avoid cash refunds unless material; preferred is a mix of credit + operational remediation. LumenX is a target logo for Q4; recommend Option C (30-day extension + priority SLT) + a small credit to acknowledge immediate impact.

Requesting exec sign-off because the ask touches launch incentives and our near-term quota/ACV targets. Proposed concession package for approval:
- $1,250 one-time account credit applied to their pilot invoice (covers token exposure and buffer)
- 30-day pilot extension (no additional cost)
- Priority routing to dedicated engineer during their launch window

If execs approve, I'll prepare a concession memo and proposed invoice adjustment. Rishi — do you want me to include a brief clause for "service unavailability credit" in the amendment?

—Kar
Director, Strategic Accounts

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: LumenX integration — production errors during canary

Thanks — legal is OK with a short amendment. Suggested clause: "Redwood will provide a one-time credit not to exceed $1,500 for confirmed service availability incidents during the pilot period; the credit will be applied to the next invoice and does not constitute admission of liability."

Note: Finance wants to record this as a commercial concession and tag to deal LUMX-2028-07-PRD. Priyom — can you confirm accounting GL for a one-time credit?

If exec sign-off is required, please route to Marissa and copy me for the amendment language.

—Laura
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Oct 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: LumenX concession package

Team — I approve the proposed concession package. Rationale: small credit, pilot extension, and operational support preserve launch momentum and align to sales/goals. Please proceed with:
1) Apply $1,250 one-time credit to LumenX pilot invoice (deal LUMX-2028-07-PRD).
2) Execute 30-day pilot extension via the SOW addendum (Laura, please attach the clause above).
3) Assign a dedicated launch engineer (Monica to coordinate schedule).

Kar, Rishi — go ahead and send the note to Samir with the offer and attach the SOW addendum draft. Priyom — finance will post the credit under GL account 5802.

—Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
